name: kit
description: Workflow skills: handoff (session continuity), operator (write and walk prod run sheets, investigate prod with approved reads, behind a prod-command guard hook), pr-review (no-auto-post review ending in a merge verdict), pr-triage (answer review comments on your PR), ship (commit, push, open or update the PR behind one go), and ticket-kickoff (Jira ticket -> worktree + plan).
